title: chore(objectui): move the console pin to objectui main (1fb1ced36243 at filing), then run every surface:browser and surface:mixed checklist item against the console built from the new pin
body:
**Maintainer-directed (direct dispatch channel).** The maintainer, in Claude Code session `session_016JB93R2KcQP4GgKaUnseVF` on 2026-10-12, verbatim:

> objectui pin 更新到最新版，并使用浏览器对前端界面进行完整的测试

This card carries both halves of that order: the pin hop, and a full browser pass of the console at the new pin.

## Readings (2026-10-12T22:15Z)

- `.objectui-sha` on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` `main` @ `abf86554` = `7578323a544e31d574804ae931b595e8f9f92c21` (set by #23061).
- `objectstack-ai/objectui` `main` tip = `1fb1ced36243c325acc801bdde26bd096a15f5f5`; the pin is **11 commits** behind it (`git rev-list --count 7578323a544e..origin/main` in an objectui checkout fetched at that time; 116 paths). The hop carries objectui#12242 (field metadata members FieldSchema refuses retire as never), objectui#12228, objectui#12238, objectui#12243, objectui#12248, objectui#12254, objectui#12244, objectui#12249, objectui#12268, and two CI commits (objectui#12222, objectui#12208 / objectui#12256).
- No open PR or open card moves the pin today (open-PR list of this repo and a title search over pin-bump cards, closed included; newest pin card #22476 is closed).
- Checklist population (`node scripts/checklist-select.mjs all --json` on `abf86554`): 65 runnable `surface:browser` items and 90 runnable `surface:mixed` items.

## Half 1 — the pin hop

Move `.objectui-sha` to the objectui `main` tip **at the moment the work starts** (`1fb1ced36243` at filing; if `main` moved since, take the new tip and say which in the PR) through the dedicated bump script, with the full second half of the pin procedure (`AGENTS.md` → Frontend; `docs/releases-maintenance.md`): the console changeset the script derives, the regenerated `sdui.manifest.json` + `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, the pin-citation re-measure, the sdui-parser lockstep, and the Console Pin Gate steps run locally. Precedent shape: #23061 / #23018.

## Half 2 — the browser pass

Every runnable `surface:browser` and `surface:mixed` item in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/`, driven in a real browser against the hop's PR head with the console built from the new pin, per `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`. One `qa-run` record per selector (`surface:browser`, `surface:mixed`), text only. Every product defect a run finds is extracted to its own card in the repository its fix lands in (console defects go to `objectstack-ai/objectui`), with a `QA-source:` line. Precedent: #21710 (hop), then #21782 and #21784 (the two records).

A failing clause whose cause lies inside the hop's objectui commits is a **regression of this hop**: the pin PR does not land until it is fixed upstream or the pin target is moved off it, and the record names it.

## Acceptance

- The pin PR's checks are green, including `check:sdui-manifest` and `check:console-sha`, and the PR states the exact objectui sha it pins.
- Both `qa-run` records exist and are linked from a comment on this card, each with every runnable item judged or listed as not-run in a handoff list; every fail carries one of the four dispositions.
- No hop regression is open against the PR when it lands.
